title: President Trump Launches New NIH Division for Women's Health
subtitle: The executive order aims to improve research into diseases that affect women, but questions remain about funding and past policies.

summary.en: President Donald Trump has signed an executive order to create a new Women's Health Division within the National Institutes of Health. First lady Melania Trump is leading the initiative, which seeks to improve research and treatment for conditions affecting women. The order also establishes a White House task force to coordinate these efforts across federal agencies. While the administration calls this a historic step, some experts have expressed concerns about recent cuts to scientific research. The move comes shortly before the upcoming November elections.
summary.zh: 總統川普簽署了一項行政命令，將在國家衛生研究院內設立一個新的婦女健康部門。第一夫人梅蘭妮亞正領導此項計畫，旨在改善針對影響女性疾病的研究與治療。該命令同時成立了一個白宮特別工作小組，以協調各聯邦機構的相關工作。儘管政府稱此為歷史性的一步，但部分專家對近期科學研究經費的削減表達了擔憂。此舉是在即將到來的十一月大選前夕所採取。

paragraphs.en: President Donald Trump recently signed an executive order to create a new Women's Health Division within the National Institutes of Health (NIH). This initiative also includes the formation of a White House task force focused on improving health outcomes for women. According to MedPage Today, the president directed the government to increase research into women's health throughout all stages of life. First lady Melania Trump, who has been a central figure in this project, stated that the goal is to discover new cures and ensure women can live their lives to the fullest.
paragraphs.zh: 總統川普 (Donald Trump) 近期簽署了一項行政命令，將在國家衛生研究院 (NIH) 內設立一個全新的婦女健康部門。這項計畫同時包含成立一個白宮特別工作小組，專注於改善婦女的健康成果。根據《MedPage Today》報導，總統指示政府應加強對婦女生命各階段健康狀況的研究。身為此計畫核心人物的第一夫人梅蘭妮亞 (Melania Trump) 表示，其目標在於發掘新的治療方法，並確保婦女能活出最精彩的人生。

paragraphs.en: The new NIH division is expected to be established within 90 days. Its primary purpose is to better coordinate research into diseases that have not been studied enough, improve diagnostic technology, and enhance medical treatments. An NIH spokesperson told STAT News that the division will work alongside the existing Office of Research on Women's Health. The goal is to increase the number of women and girls included in clinical trials and ensure that biological differences are properly considered in scientific research.
paragraphs.zh: 這個新的國家衛生研究院部門預計將在九十天內成立。其主要目的在於更有效地協調針對研究不足之疾病的調查，改善診斷技術，並提升醫療處置。一位國家衛生研究院的發言人向《STAT News》表示，該部門將與現有的婦女健康研究辦公室並肩合作。目標是增加臨床試驗中女性與女童的參與人數，並確保在科學研究中能適當考量生理差異。

paragraphs.en: During the announcement, President Trump expressed surprise that such a division did not already exist within the NIH. He noted that he had asked the first lady if the organization truly lacked a specific department for women's health before deciding to move forward with the order. The new White House task force will be led by White House chief of staff Susie Wiles, who has recently undergone treatment for breast cancer. Other members of the task force include Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr., acting FDA Commissioner Kyle Diamantas, and the director of the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, Erica Schwartz.
paragraphs.zh: 在宣布此消息時，川普總統對於國家衛生研究院內竟然尚未存在此類部門感到驚訝。他提到，在決定推動該行政命令前，曾詢問第一夫人該機構是否真的缺乏專門的婦女健康部門。新的白宮特別工作小組將由白宮幕僚長威爾斯 (Susie Wiles) 領導，她近期才剛接受過乳癌治療。工作小組的其他成員包括衛生部長小羅伯特·甘迺迪 (Robert F. Kennedy Jr.)、代理食品藥物管理局局長狄亞曼塔斯 (Kyle Diamantas)，以及疾病管制與預防中心主任史瓦茲 (Erica Schwartz)。

paragraphs.en: This announcement arrives at a time when the administration's approach to scientific research has been a subject of debate. STAT News reports that funding for general scientific research has faced challenges since the president returned to the White House. Some scientists have expressed concern that their work was in danger because of broader government efforts to limit programs related to diversity and gender. While the new executive order aims to boost research into areas like maternal health, mental health, and menopause, it does not include specific funding goals. The Department of Health and Human Services will cover the administrative costs of the task force.
paragraphs.zh: 這項宣布正值政府對科學研究的態度引發爭議之際。《STAT News》報導指出，自總統重返白宮以來，一般科學研究的經費一直面臨挑戰。部分科學家擔憂，由於政府廣泛限制與多元性及性別相關的計畫，他們的研究工作恐將陷入危機。儘管這項新的行政命令旨在促進產婦健康、心理健康與更年期等領域的研究，但並未包含具體的經費目標。衛生與公共服務部將負擔該工作小組的行政成本。

paragraphs.en: Experts in the medical community have been calling for changes for some time. Basmah Safdar, a physician and director of Women’s Health Research at Yale, wrote in a recent commentary that there is a need for new funding structures to address the lack of investment in women’s health. According to MedPage Today, the administration's move comes just weeks before the November 3 elections. Recent polling data suggests that healthcare is a very important issue for many voters, particularly women.
paragraphs.zh: 醫學界的專家早已呼籲進行改革。耶魯大學 (Yale) 婦女健康研究主任、醫師薩夫達 (Basmah Safdar) 在近期的一篇評論中寫道，目前亟需建立新的資金結構，以解決婦女健康領域投資不足的問題。根據《MedPage Today》報導，政府此舉是在十一月三日大選前幾週所採取。近期的民調數據顯示，醫療保健對許多選民，特別是女性而言，是一項極為重要的議題。

paragraphs.en: It remains unclear how this new division will interact with the administration's previous actions that reduced federal programs focused on diversity and inclusion. Some observers are waiting to see if this new focus on women’s health will lead to significant changes or if it will face the same difficulties that other research projects have encountered under the current administration. As the NIH prepares to set up the new division, the scientific community will be watching to see how these plans are put into action and whether they will provide the support needed to improve health outcomes for women across the country.
paragraphs.zh: 目前尚不清楚這個新部門將如何與政府先前削減聯邦多元與包容性計畫的行動相互協調。部分觀察家正拭目以待，觀察此項對婦女健康的新關注是否會帶來重大變革，還是會面臨與現任政府下其他研究計畫相同的困境。隨著國家衛生研究院準備設立新部門，科學界將密切關注這些計畫如何落實，以及它們是否能提供必要的支持，以改善全國婦女的健康成果。

quiz.question: According to the article, who is designated to lead the newly formed White House task force on women's health?
quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。根據文章第三段明確指出，新成立的白宮工作小組將由白宮幕僚長 Susie Wiles 領導。選項 A (Erica Schwartz) 是 CDC 主任，選項 C (Melania Trump) 是此計畫的核心人物但非組長，選項 D (Robert F. Kennedy Jr.) 是衛生部長，他們皆為小組成員但非領導者。

quiz.question: Based on the text, why might the scientific community be skeptical about the long-term impact of this new executive order?

options.A: Because the NIH has already successfully addressed all women's health issues.
options.B: Because the order explicitly forbids future funding for maternal health research.
options.C: Because there is a contradiction between this initiative and the administration's broader efforts to limit diversity and inclusion programs.
options.D: Because the new division is expected to take more than a year to establish.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。根據文章第四段與第六段，科學界對此持保留態度，因為政府一方面推動女性健康研究，另一方面卻在削減與多元及包容性相關的計畫，這兩者之間存在潛在的政策矛盾。選項 A 與事實不符；選項 B 文章並未提到禁止，僅提到缺乏具體資金目標；選項 D 錯誤，文章提到預計在 90 天內成立，非一年以上。

quiz.question: In the fourth paragraph, what does the word 'boost' mean as it is used in the context of the executive order?

options.A: To increase or improve the progress of something.
options.B: To physically lift something to a higher level.
options.C: To criticize an existing research program.
options.D: To cancel a project due to lack of funding.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 A。在此語境中，'boost' 意指推動、促進或提升研究的進展。文章提到行政命令旨在提升（boost）針對母嬰健康、心理健康等領域的研究。選項 B 是該詞的字面義，在此不適用；選項 C 和 D 與提升研究的正面意涵完全相反。

options.A: It highlights the personal health struggles of the first lady.
options.B: It focuses primarily on the upcoming November 3 elections.
options.C: It details the administrative costs of the Department of Health and Human Services.
options.D: It examines the announcement of a new NIH division for women's health and the surrounding political and scientific context.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 D。本文的核心主旨是報導川普政府宣布成立 NIH 女性健康部門的消息，並進一步探討此舉在政治時機、科學界反應以及政府既有政策矛盾下的複雜背景。選項 A、B、C 皆僅為文章中的部分細節，不足以涵蓋整篇文章探討的廣度與主題。
